name: supply-chain-network-planner
description: Governed supply-chain evidence, network planning, financial evaluation, and risk registration for Codex

interface.shortDescription: Build governed evidence for supply-chain decisions.
interface.longDescription: Publishes reviewed planning datasets, prepares immutable network snapshots, evaluates current and candidate networks, calculates bounded investment economics, and publishes evidence-linked risk registers.
interface.defaultPrompt: Analyze the supply-chain decision using the smallest necessary set of source-backed, deterministic planning capabilities.
